---
title: "Browse the palettes"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(transformerpalettes)
```

Every palette in transformerpalettes, with its colors, where it came from, and the
toy photo, episode still or comic panel it was checked against. Most
characters have a toy palette and a cartoon palette; a few have a comic one
too. Filter by medium, faction, combiner team, role or what kind of plot the
palette suits, click a swatch to copy its hex code, and use
**Suggest a change** on any card to open a prefilled GitHub issue where you can
propose different colors or attach a better photograph. Missing someone?
[Request a character](https://github.com/bmaitner/transformerpalettes/issues/new?template=new-character.yml).

```{r data, results = "asis"}
stats <- tf_palette_stats()
cw <- tf_characters
cw$colours <- unname(tf_palettes[cw$palette])
cw <- merge(cw, stats[, c("palette", "min_de", "min_de_deutan", "min_de_protan",
                          "min_de_tritan", "lum_range", "hue_spread",
                          "categorical", "colorblind", "sequential", "diverging")],
            by = "palette", sort = FALSE)
cw <- cw[order(match(cw$palette, names(tf_palettes))), ]
num <- c("min_de", "min_de_deutan", "min_de_protan", "min_de_tritan",
         "lum_range", "hue_spread")
cw[num] <- lapply(cw[num], round, 1)
payload <- list(
  generated = format(Sys.Date()),
  version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("transformerpalettes")),
  repo = "https://github.com/bmaitner/transformerpalettes",
  teams = tf_teams(),
  media = tf_media(),
  palettes = cw
)
json <- jsonlite::toJSON(payload, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null", dataframe = "rows")
json <- gsub("</", "<\\/", json, fixed = TRUE)
cat('<script id="tf-data" type="application/json">', json, '</script>', sep = "\n")
```

.tb-card { border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 8px; padding: .8rem .9rem; background: #fff; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .45rem; border-top: 4px solid #999; }

  <div><label for="tb-q">Search</label><input id="tb-q" type="text" placeholder="name, alt mode, description"></div>
  <div><label for="tb-medium">Medium</label><select id="tb-medium"><option value="">All media</option></select></div>
  <div><label for="tb-faction">Faction</label><select id="tb-faction"><option value="">Both factions</option></select></div>
  <div><label for="tb-team">Team</label><select id="tb-team"><option value="">All teams</option></select></div>
  <div><label for="tb-role">Role</label><select id="tb-role"><option value="">Any role</option><option value="leader">leader</option><option value="combiner torso">combiner torso</option><option value="combiner limb">combiner limb</option><option value="standalone">standalone</option><option value="combined form">combined form</option><option value="subgroup member">subgroup member</option></select></div>
  <div><label for="tb-n">Colors</label><select id="tb-n"><option value="">Any number</option><option value="3">3</option><option value="4">4</option><option value="5">5</option><option value="6">6</option></select></div>

<script>
(function () {
  var data = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("tf-data").textContent);
  var pals = data.palettes;
  var repo = data.repo;
  var grid = document.getElementById("tb-grid");
  var count = document.getElementById("tb-count");
  var toast = document.getElementById("tb-toast");
  var q = document.getElementById("tb-q");
  var selMedium = document.getElementById("tb-medium");
  var selFaction = document.getElementById("tb-faction");
  var selTeam = document.getElementById("tb-team");
  var selRole = document.getElementById("tb-role");
  var selN = document.getElementById("tb-n");
  var selSort = document.getElementById("tb-sort");
  var showPhotos = document.getElementById("tb-photos");
  var uses = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".tb-use"));

  function uniq(arr) { return arr.filter(function (v, i, a) { return a.indexOf(v) === i; }); }
  function esc(s) { return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) { return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]; }); }
  function textColor(hex) {
    var r = parseInt(hex.slice(1, 3), 16), g = parseInt(hex.slice(3, 5), 16), b = parseInt(hex.slice(5, 7), 16);
    return (0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b) > 150 ? "#111" : "#fff";
  }
  function fill(sel, values) {
    values.forEach(function (v) { var o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = v; o.textContent = v; sel.appendChild(o); });
  }
  fill(selMedium, data.media);
  fill(selFaction, uniq(pals.map(function (p) { return p.faction; })));
  function refreshTeams() {
    var current = selTeam.value;
    selTeam.innerHTML = '<option value="">All teams</option>';
    var teams = data.teams.filter(function (t) {
      return pals.some(function (p) { return p.team === t && (!selFaction.value || p.faction === selFaction.value); });
    });
    fill(selTeam, teams);
    selTeam.value = teams.indexOf(current) >= 0 ? current : "";
  }
  refreshTeams();

  function issueUrl(p) {
    var params = new URLSearchParams({
      template: "palette-correction.yml",
      title: "[" + p.palette + "] palette change",
      labels: "palette",
      palette: p.palette,
      medium: p.medium,
      current_colours: p.colours.join(" "),
      reference: p.source
    });
    return repo + "/issues/new?" + params.toString();
  }

  function card(p) {
    var strip = p.colours.map(function (h) {
      return '<button type="button" data-hex="' + h + '" title="Copy ' + h + '" style="background:' + h + '"><span style="color:' + textColor(h) + '">' + h + '</span></button>';
    }).join("");
    var hexes = p.colours.map(function (h) { return '<code data-hex="' + h + '">' + h + "</code>"; }).join("");
    var badges = ["categorical", "colorblind", "sequential", "diverging"].map(function (u) {
      return '<span class="tb-badge' + (p[u] ? " on" : "") + '">' + u + "</span>";
    }).join("");
    var where = [p.faction, p.team, p.role].filter(function (x) { return x != null && x !== ""; }).join(" &middot; ");
    var refWord = p.medium === "toy" ? "Toy photo" : p.medium === "cartoon" ? "Episode still" : p.medium === "g2" ? "G2 toy photo" : "Comic panel";
    var photo = p.image
      ? '<div class="tb-photo"><a href="' + esc(p.image) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><img loading="lazy" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" src="' + esc(p.image) + '" alt="' + refWord + ': ' + esc(p.character) + '"></a></div>'
      : '<div class="tb-photo"><span class="tb-nophoto">No reference image linked yet. Know a good one? Use Suggest a change.</span></div>';
    var photoLink = p.image
      ? '<a href="' + esc(p.image) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">' + refWord + '</a>'
      : "";
    return '<div class="tb-card ' + esc(p.faction.toLowerCase()) + (showPhotos.checked ? " show-photo" : "") + '" data-palette="' + esc(p.palette) + '">' +
      "<h4>" + esc(p.palette) + '<span class="tb-medium ' + esc(p.medium) + '">' + esc(p.medium) + "</span></h4>" +
      '<div class="tb-meta"><b>' + esc(p.character) + "</b> &middot; " + where + "</div>" +
      '<div class="tb-meta">' + esc(p.alt_mode) + " &middot; " + esc(p.year) + "</div>" +
      '<div class="tb-strip">' + strip + "</div>" +
      '<div class="tb-hex">' + hexes + "</div>" +
      '<p class="tb-desc">' + esc(p.description) + "</p>" +
      '<div class="tb-badges">' + badges + "</div>" +
      '<div class="tb-stats">min &Delta;E ' + p.min_de + " (deutan " + p.min_de_deutan + ", protan " + p.min_de_protan + ", tritan " + p.min_de_tritan + ") &middot; lightness range " + p.lum_range + " &middot; hue spread " + p.hue_spread + "&deg;</div>" +
      '<div class="tb-code"><code>tf_palette("' + esc(p.base) + '"' + (p.medium === "toy" ? "" : ', medium = "' + esc(p.medium) + '"') + ')</code></div>' +
      photo +
      '<div class="tb-links">' +
        '<a href="' + esc(p.source) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">TFWiki: ' + esc(p.character) + "</a>" +
        photoLink +
        '<a class="tb-suggest" href="' + issueUrl(p) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Suggest a change</a>' +
      "</div>" +
    "</div>";
  }

  function render() {
    var terms = q.value.trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    var wantUses = uses.filter(function (u) { return u.checked; }).map(function (u) { return u.value; });
    var out = pals.filter(function (p) {
      if (selMedium.value && p.medium !== selMedium.value) return false;
      if (selFaction.value && p.faction !== selFaction.value) return false;
      if (selTeam.value && p.team !== selTeam.value) return false;
      if (selRole.value && p.role !== selRole.value) return false;
      if (selN.value && p.colours.length !== +selN.value) return false;
      for (var i = 0; i < wantUses.length; i++) if (!p[wantUses[i]]) return false;
      if (terms.length) {
        var hay = [p.palette, p.character, p.medium, p.faction, p.team, p.role, p.alt_mode, p.description].join(" ").toLowerCase();
        for (var j = 0; j < terms.length; j++) if (hay.indexOf(terms[j]) < 0) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
    var s = selSort.value;
    if (s === "palette") out.sort(function (a, b) { return a.palette < b.palette ? -1 : 1; });
    else if (s === "team") out.sort(function (a, b) { var ta = a.team || "", tb = b.team || ""; return ta < tb ? -1 : ta > tb ? 1 : 0; });
    else if (s === "year") out.sort(function (a, b) { return (a.year || 0) - (b.year || 0); });
    else if (s === "min_de" || s === "lum_range") out.sort(function (a, b) { return b[s] - a[s]; });
    else if (s === "cvd") out.sort(function (a, b) { return Math.min(b.min_de_deutan, b.min_de_protan, b.min_de_tritan) - Math.min(a.min_de_deutan, a.min_de_protan, a.min_de_tritan); });
    count.textContent = out.length + " of " + pals.length + " palettes (transformerpalettes " + data.version + ", " + data.generated + ")";
    grid.innerHTML = out.length ? out.map(card).join("") : '<div class="tb-empty">No palettes match. Loosen a filter, or request a character with the link below.</div>';
  }

  function copy(hex) {
    var done = function () { toast.textContent = "Copied " + hex; toast.classList.add("show"); setTimeout(function () { toast.classList.remove("show"); }, 1200); };
    if (navigator.clipboard) navigator.clipboard.writeText(hex).then(done, done); else done();
  }
  grid.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var t = e.target.closest("[data-hex]");
    if (t) { e.preventDefault(); copy(t.getAttribute("data-hex")); }
  });
  [q, selMedium, selTeam, selRole, selN, selSort].forEach(function (el) { el.addEventListener("input", render); el.addEventListener("change", render); });
  selFaction.addEventListener("change", function () { refreshTeams(); render(); });
  uses.forEach(function (u) { u.addEventListener("change", render); });
  showPhotos.addEventListener("change", function () {
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(grid.querySelectorAll(".tb-card"), function (c) { c.classList.toggle("show-photo", showPhotos.checked); });
  });

  // Deep links: ?medium=cartoon&faction=Decepticon&team=Constructicons&role=combined%20form&use=colorblind&q=truck
  var qs = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  if (qs.get("medium")) selMedium.value = qs.get("medium");
  if (qs.get("faction")) selFaction.value = qs.get("faction");
  refreshTeams();
  if (qs.get("team")) selTeam.value = qs.get("team");
  if (qs.get("role")) selRole.value = qs.get("role");
  if (qs.get("q")) q.value = qs.get("q");
  if (qs.get("use")) uses.forEach(function (u) { u.checked = qs.get("use").split(",").indexOf(u.value) >= 0; });
  render();
})();
</script>

## Suggesting changes

Every palette here is an approximation read off toy photographs, so
corrections are welcome. Each card links to a prefilled GitHub issue form:

- **Suggest a change** if a color is wrong, missing, or should be removed, or
  if the description, alternate mode, year or reference image is off. Say
  which hex codes you would add, change or drop and why. For a toy palette a
  photo under neutral light is the best evidence; for a cartoon palette a
  clean episode still; for a comic palette the issue and page.
- **Ask for a cartoon or comic version** of a character that only has a toy
  palette by using Suggest a change on the toy card and picking "Add a
  cartoon or comic version" as the kind of change. Comic palettes are added
  a team at a time from specific Marvel issues, so say which issue you have
  in mind.
- [Request a character](https://github.com/bmaitner/transformerpalettes/issues/new?template=new-character.yml)
  if a Transformer or team you care about is not covered yet. The
  [wishlist](https://github.com/bmaitner/transformerpalettes/blob/main/WISHLIST.md)
  shows what is already queued.

You need a GitHub account to open an issue. If you would rather not, email the
maintainer listed in the package DESCRIPTION.
